==Preparation==
{{See also|Treasure Trails/Guide/Emote clues/Items}}
[[Clue scroll (hard)|Hard clue scrolls]] have a variable amount of steps, with each clue ranging between four-to-six (4-6) steps long. These steps may require completion of multiple high difficulty quests, as well as the ability to defeat multiple high level enemies. For a suggested inventory setup, see the [[Treasure Trails/Strategies#Setups | Setups page]].
